courses.name: M.Sc. in Agriculture
courses.summary: M.Sc. Agriculture programmes provide postgraduate study of agricultural science and related economic, biological or extension disciplines. Universities may offer specialist entry in agronomy, crop protection, genetics, soil science, microbiology, economics or extension education. Regular programmes commonly combine advanced coursework, practical methods, seminars and a supervised research thesis. Compare the specialisation, prior-degree requirements, institutional eligibility, teaching language and delivery format before applying.

courses.name: M.A. in English and Literature
aliases: Master of Arts in English Literature
courses.summary: English-literature master’s programmes examine literary texts, language and cultural expression through advanced interpretation and research. Curricula may include literary theory, linguistics, comparative or regional traditions and a dissertation. Compare required prior study, period and regional coverage, research options, teaching language and complete costs.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.A. English programmes, qualifying subjects or degrees, study structure, duration, tuition and programme-specific admission requirements.

courses.name: Master of Commerce
courses.summary: The Master of Commerce is a two-year postgraduate degree in commerce, usually open to graduates who hold a B.Com., BBA or a related business degree. Study builds on undergraduate accounting and finance with advanced financial and management accounting, corporate finance, financial markets and investment analysis, taxation, business research methods and economics, and many programmes offer a specialisation such as finance, accounting or banking. Assessment typically includes a research project or dissertation. Graduates often work in accounting, finance and banking roles, prepare for professional accountancy examinations, or continue to doctoral study and teaching.

courses.name: M.Sc. in Mathematics
courses.summary: Mathematics master’s programmes develop advanced reasoning through pure and applied mathematical study. Curricula may include analysis, algebra, differential equations, probability, computation and specialist research or project work. Compare qualifying subjects, specialisations, assessment, language, duration and complete costs.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.Sc. Mathematics programmes, qualifying subjects or degrees, study structure, duration, tuition and programme-specific admission requirements.

universities.summary: Annamalai University is a public state university established in 1929 at Annamalainagar, Chidambaram. Its regular agriculture master’s programmes combine coursework with thesis research. The university also conducts separate two-year Arts, Commerce and Science master’s degrees at its own PG Extension Centre in Salamedu, Villupuram, with a distinct admission prospectus and fee schedule.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Faculty of Agriculture has an experimental farm, orchard, livestock farm, agro-meteorological observatory and automatic weather station. Its departments include Agronomy, Entomology, Plant Pathology, Agricultural Microbiology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Economics and Extension Education. The separate Villupuram PG Extension Centre lists computing and science laboratories, NSS, sports, cultural activities and field visits for its own regular students.
universities.cityProfile: The main campus is at Annamalainagar in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, with postal code 608002. The university also runs a PG Extension Centre at Salamedu, Villupuram; those programmes have a separate campus and admission prospectus.
universities.practicalExposure: Agriculture master’s students complete major, minor, supporting and common coursework, a seminar and supervised thesis research under an advisory committee. The common regulations allocate 30 of 70 credits to thesis research and require 80%attendance separately in theory and practical subjects. The separate Villupuram centre lists an exclusive computer laboratory and laboratories for Chemistry, Zoology and Biotechnology, alongside field visits and special lectures.
universities.hostelOverview: Hostel accommodation is available for agriculture students. The historical 2025-26 annual hostel-and-mess charges were 60000 INR for the men’s Sekizhar Block with attached bathroom and 50000 INR for Thamarai Illam women’s hostel, plus 5000 INRcaution deposit. Current charges and room allotment need a new quotation; category-specific concessions have separate conditions. Villupuram extension-centre applicants should request that centre’s current accommodation arrangements separately; main-campus agriculture hostel charges do not establish a Villupuram place.
universities.studentSupport: The Faculty of Agriculture has postgraduate advisory committees and career preparation. The Villupuram PG Extension Centre lists subject faculty, computing/science laboratories and a placement cell. Confirm the exact campus, academic supervisor, required documents and student services for the chosen programme.

faq.question: Is Annamalai University public or private?
faq.answer: It is a public state university at Annamalainagar, Chidambaram, established in 1929. UGC lists the institution as a State University; recognition of a university is distinct from any programme-specific professional accreditation.

faq.question: Which agriculture admission route applies?
faq.answer: The eligibility conditions below apply to Indian applicants with a four-year B.Sc. (Ag.) or B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture degree using regular TNAU admissions. Other prior degrees and foreign-national admission require separate assessment. The four-year qualifying degree, institution category, academic marks and entrance selection all need to be met.

faq.question: Are the Agriculture master’s taught in English?
faq.answer: The Faculty of Agriculture’s 2019-20 policy specifies English instruction. Regular teaching and thesis research are combined in its master’s programmes.

faq.question: How long does an agriculture master’s take?
faq.answer: The regular M.Sc. Agriculture programme takes two academic years across four semesters. Common regulations specify 70 credits, with 40 credits of coursework and seminar and 30 of  thesis research.

faq.question: How are Agriculture master’s students selected?
faq.answer: TNAU conducts the regular postgraduate admissions process and common entrance examination. Final admission remains conditional on academic eligibility, original records, selection and the relevant allotment.

faq.question: How do I apply for an Agriculture master’s?
faq.answer: Use admissionsatpgschool.tnau.ac.in for the notified TNAU postgraduate cycle and select the Annamalai University programme. The 2026 master’s application is closed; future applicants need the new cycle’s notice and dates.

faq.question: What is the Agriculture intake baseline?
faq.answer: Annamalai scheduled first-year M.Sc. Agriculture classes for 22 October 2026 at 10 am. That historical date does not announce a future intake; the next application and class-start schedule must be newly notified.

faq.question: What should I budget for Agriculture study?
faq.answer: Obtain a current full fee quotation for the chosen aided or self-supporting category. Include tuition, compulsory charges, hostel, mess, deposits and examination costs; a historic combined annual charge is not a current tuition figure.

faq.question: Is Agriculture hostel accommodation available?
faq.answer: Agriculture students have university hostel options, including Thamarai Illam for women and Sekizhar Block for men. The 2025-26 brochure gives room-and-mess charges plus caution deposit; request current charges and allocation before accepting a room.

faq.question: Can final-year agriculture graduates apply?
faq.answer: The 2026 TNAU notice allowed final-year and final-semester applicants to apply with available completed-semester records. They still had to meet final admission requirements and submit the required qualifying certificate at admission.

faq.question: How do aided and self-supporting options differ?
faq.answer: The current admission notification advertises both categories for the same agriculture specialisations. Their charges differ, so compare the admission category and complete budget before choosing; neither category guarantees admission or employment.

faq.question: Which programmes are offered at the Villupuram PG Extension Centre?
faq.answer: The university’s own centre at Salamedu, Villupuram, lists two-year regular MA English, MCom and MSc Mathematics, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Zoology and Computer Science. These programmes have a separate qualification table, interview process and fee schedule from the Chidambaram agriculture routes.

faq.question: What are the Villupuram entry conditions and first-year charges?
faq.answer: Each programme has a specific qualifying degree and, where stated, a main-subject mark requirement. For the 2026–27cycle, applicants must be 20–28 on 20 August 2026, with five-year SC/SCA/ST relaxation; SC/ST candidates need a pass as the minimum academic qualification. Selection uses qualifying-exam performance and an interview. The prospectus lists first-year tuition plus other charges from ₹5,350 to ₹26,650 by degree. Its 20 August 2026 application deadline has passed; future applicants need the next notice.

Annamalai University is a public state university established in 1929 at Annamalainagar, Chidambaram. Its regular agriculture master’s programmes combine specialist coursework with supervised thesis research. Indian agriculture graduates apply through TNAU counselling; aided and self-supporting categories have different costs. Teaching is in English and study requires campus attendance.

The Faculty of Agriculture has an experimental farm, orchard, livestock farm, agro-meteorological observatory and automatic weather station. Its departments include Agronomy, Entomology, Plant Pathology, Agricultural Microbiology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Economics and Extension Education.

The main campus is at Annamalainagar in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, with postal code 608002. The university also runs a PG Extension Centre at Salamedu, Villupuram; those programmes have a separate campus and admission prospectus.

Agriculture master’s students complete major, minor, supporting and common coursework, a seminar and supervised thesis research under an advisory committee. The common regulations allocate 30 of 70 credits to thesis research and require 80%attendance separately in theory and practical subjects.

Hostel accommodation is available for agriculture students. The historical 2025-26 annual hostel-and-mess charges were 60000 INR for the men’s Sekizhar Block with attached bathroom and 50000 INR for Thamarai Illam women’s hostel, plus 5000 INRcaution deposit. Current charges and room allotment need a new quotation; category-specific concessions have separate conditions.

The Faculty of Agriculture has a placement cell for career preparation and employer interaction. Postgraduate advisory committees guide course planning and thesis research. Students Traffic can help assess the degree route, required records and total study budget.
